With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some benefits according to your needs.

Our benefits include:

Respiramos e somos referência no varejo, lideramos pelo exemplo, inspiramos e desenvolvemos o potencial das nossas pessoas para fazerem sempre mais e melhor pelo nosso cliente!

Há mais de 40 anos, temos ao nosso lado os principais varejistas do Brasil, e um time igualmente capacitado para fazê-los chegar ainda mais longe! Com autonomia e flexibilidade, nossas pessoas buscam diariamente construir soluções de tecnologia para gestão que impactem os negócios pelo Brasil e América Latina.

Se você é assim como a gente e tem o desejo genuíno de ajudar negócios por meio de uma Tecnologia feita por e para pessoas, então aqui é a sua próxima parada!

Quer fazer parte do nosso time de Retail como Analista de Implantação Jr - PCD ?

Quais desafios nós temos para você?

A área de serviços tem como foco prestar consultoria e apoio aos clientes e fazer com que o processo de implantação dos nossos sistemas sejam o mais suave possível. Para isso, precisamos nos preparar, nos antecipar em possíveis situações que possam ocorrer e já mitigar os riscos identificados. Tudo isso exige muito planejamento e constante busca por conhecimento. A área de projetos é super desafiadora e dinâmica, possibilitando grande aprendizado do negócio de software e dos nossos clientes.

  • Instalação e configuração do sistema: O analista instala o software nos servidores do cliente e realiza as configurações necessárias para o funcionamento adequado.
  • Migração de dados: Em muitos casos, é necessário migrar dados de sistemas antigos para o novo sistema. O analista garante que a migração seja feita de forma segura e precisa.
  • Testes: Após a instalação e configuração, o analista realiza testes para verificar se o sistema está funcionando corretamente e se atende aos requisitos do cliente.
  • Treinamento de usuários: O analista ministra treinamentos para os usuários do sistema, ensinando-os a utilizar as funcionalidades e a realizar as tarefas do dia a dia.
  • Suporte pós-implantação: Após a implantação, o analista oferece suporte técnico aos usuários, auxiliando na resolução de problemas e dúvidas.
  • Documentação do processo: O analista documenta todas as etapas do processo de implantação, desde o planejamento até o suporte pós-implantação.
  • Relatórios de progresso: O analista elabora relatórios de progresso, informando o status da implantação e os resultados obtidos.

Requisitos para você mover o varejo junto com a gente :

  • Gostar de pessoas e de construir boas relações.
  • Ter prazer em ajudar e ensinar, com paciência e empatia.
  • Boa comunicação, clareza e desenvoltura para transmitir informações.
  • Perfil proativo, persistente e com facilidade de aprendizado.
  • Resiliência diante de desafios e disposição para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Afinidade com tecnologia e curiosidade para aprender continuamente.

Diferenciais que fazem brilhar os olhos:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou Contabilidade.
  • Experiência em implantação de softwares.
  • Vivência com consultoria e/ou capacitação de pessoas.

Nós somos a BHS!

O que a gente espera de você?

Main responsibilities

  • Apoiar squads e times de desenvolvimento no uso de Azure DevOps (pipelines CI/CD, versionamento de código);

Requirements and skills

Desejamos:

  • Criação, configuração e monitoramento de máquinas virtuais, redes virtuais, balanceadores de carga e storage accounts;

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Azure CLI, PowerShell, ARM Templates, Bicep ou Terraform);

  • Experiência em monitoramento e observabilidade com Azure Monitor, Log Analytics e Application Insights;
  • Conhecimentos em segurança e conformidade na nuvem (NSG, Firewalls, Key Vault, políticas de governança);
  • Vivência em otimização de custos em ambientes cloud;
  • Disponibilidade de atuar presencial esporadicamente, podendo ser entre 1 a 2x no mês em Belo Horizonte/MG.

Diferenciais:

  • Noções de containers e orquestração (AKS, Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Certificações Microsoft (AZ-900, AZ-104, AZ-305 ou equivalents).

Additional information

O que você pode esperar de nós?

Na BHS, cuidamos do seu bem-estar como prioridade número um. Estamos aqui para garantir que sua experiência seja incrível, com todo o suporte que você precisar. Por aqui você vai encontrar:

Parcerias e convênios diversos em educação, saúde e lazer (Universidades, escolas de Idioma, academias, clínicas de saúde...);

Cultura de Feedback contínuo, com: Feedbacks semestrais, 1:1, PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) e BHS Experience.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PetroReconcavo, uma empresa produtora de petróleo e gás natural, especializada na operação de campos maduros em bacias terrestres. Trabalhamos para sermos a mais segura, eficiente e lucrativa operadora independente de óleo e gás, e o nosso objetivo é liderar a transformação da Indústria Onshore no Brasil. Acreditamos na diversidade e atuamos para construir um ambiente colaborativo, inclusivo e respeitoso. Nos orgulhamos em impactar positivamente as regiões onde atuamos, e convidamos você a fazer parte do nosso time!

Posição em aberto: Pessoa Geofísica Sênior

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Interpretação Sísmica: Realizar interpretação dos dados sísmicos dos diversos campos da companhia, garantindo análises para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Mapeamento Estrutural e Volumetria: Elaborar mapas estruturais e efetuar cálculos volumétricos determinísticos e probabilísticos de óleo e gás, assegurando consistência técnica e alinhamento com os padrões da indústria.
  • Definição de Locação de Poços: Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Geologia e Engenharia de Reservatórios na definição de novas locações para perfuração, otimizando o desenvolvimento de campos e a recuperação de reservas.
  • Exploração e Novas Oportunidades: Conduzir a interpretação e avaliação de dados sísmicos de blocos exploratórios, além de analisar potenciais novas aquisições, contribuindo para a expansão do portfólio de ativos da empresa.
  • Planejamento Estratégico: Participar ativamente da elaboração do planejamento estratégico para o desenvolvimento dos campos, com foco no aumento sustentável das reservas.
  • Aquisição e Processamento de Dados: Apoiar nas etapas de aquisição e processamento de dados geofísicos, assegurando qualidade, integridade e adequação técnica para os projetos.
  • Compliance e Sustentabilidade: Atuar em conformidade com os sistemas de gestão de SSMS, qualidade e SGIP, promovendo a melhoria contínua, a segurança operacional e a sustentabilidade das operações.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência sólida em interpretação sísmica e no desenvolvimento de campos de petróleo, com capacidade comprovada de conduzir projetos de forma independente — desde o carregamento de dados e amarração de poços até a apresentação final para equipes técnicas, diretoria e/ou conselho.
  • Onshore: Experiência prévia em campos terrestres será considerada um diferencial relevante.
  • Softwares de Interpretação: Conhecimento em ferramentas de interpretação geofísica; domínio do Kingdom será considerado um diferencial.
  • Trabalho Colaborativo: Habilidade para atuar em equipes multidisciplinares, integrando geologia, engenharia de reservatórios e demais áreas correlatas.
  • Segurança e Sustentabilidade: Comprometimento com os princípios de segurança operacional, proteção ao meio ambiente e excelência em performance empresarial.

Informações adicionais

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e seus dependentes
  • Vale Refeição ou Refeitório
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Cultura
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Vale transporte ou transporte fornecido pela empresa
  • Atendimento médico 24h por videochamada, extensivo a dependentes
  • Auxílio Educação conforme política da empresa
  • Plataforma de desenvolvimento e treinamentos
  • Parcerias com instituições para cursos de Idiomas, Graduação e Pós Graduação
  • Seguro de Vida e Auxílio Funeral sem desconto
  • Empréstimo Consignado
  • Licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de 20 dias
  • Aplicativo com descontos em aproximadamente 30 mil estabelecimentos (NewValue)
  • Participação de lucros e resultados (PLR)
  • Vacina da gripe para os colaboradores
  • Programa de Saúde e bem-estar (orientação psicológica, nutricional - entre outros)
  • Acesso ao Wellhub (Gympass)

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

We are looking for a detail-oriented, customer-obsessed Benefits Associate, Operations to join our growing Benefits Operations team. This role is pivotal in supporting the day-to-day delivery of employee benefits programs across multiple countries. As a Benefits Coordinator, you will provide administrative and operational support to ensure our employees and clients enjoy a seamless, informed, and positive benefits experience.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with early experience in HR or benefits administration who is looking to grow in a global, mission-driven organization.

What you bring

  • Experienced in employee benefits, HR operations, or a similar administrative role.
  • Strong customer service skills with clear written and verbal communication.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle high-volume tasks accurately.
  • Solid organizational and time management skills; able to meet deadlines and shift priorities.
  • Comfortable working on multiple tools like Zendesk, Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Empathetic and professional when interacting with employees and clients.
  • Solution-oriented and eager to improve processes and service delivery.
  • Team player with a collaborative mindset and openness to feedback.

Key responsibilities

  • Respond to employee and client queries related to benefits via Zendesk and email.
  • Deliver clear, empathetic, and informative support across topics like plan details, enrollment, claims, and billing.
  • Escalate complex issues appropriately and collaborate with Benefits Specialists to ensure resolution.
  • Accurately handle benefits data: validation, updates, and preparation for reporting.
  • Support enrollment and changes (e.g. new joiners, life events, terminations) in both internal and external benefits systems.
  • Assist with invoice audits and data checks, collaborating with the Accounting team to support accurate payment processing.
  • Maintain invoice tracking datasets accurately on a monthly basis.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams like Payroll, Legal, Lifecycle, and Finance, and ask for support when needed.
  • Support regular audits and data quality reviews across systems.
  • Track and escalate exceptions or inaccuracies, working with the Quality Analyst and Benefits Specialists.
  • Maintain internal documentation (in Notion or other tools) to reflect updates and recurring learnings.
  • Suggest improvements to benefits FAQs or support articles to enhance clarity for internal or external users.
  • Be an internal and external champion of Remote's values and Benefits team's goals.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager, Benefits Operations

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We aim to pay above in-location rates and support global talent-hiring. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

We foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. All compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is

$26,100 - $58,700 USD

Remote is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we prioritize a sense of belonging.

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  • Please fill out the form below and upload your CV in PDF format.
  • Submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use at Remote.
  • If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested, you may add a LinkedIn profile.

Remote is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants from all ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, ages, abilities, and backgrounds to apply. We are open to accommodations during the interview process upon request.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

description:
Estagiário(a) de Controle da Qualidade - Rótula Metalúrgica Ltda

Com 36 anos de história, somos uma das maiores empresas de metalurgia do Norte e Nordeste , destacando-nos pela inovação e excelência no setor. Desde nossa fundação em 1989, temos sido referência em fabricação de estruturas metálicas e mistas , contando com a mais moderna e completa linha de maquinário industrial. Nosso compromisso com a seriedade e a dedicação nos levou a conquistar o reconhecimento e a confiança no mercado de estruturas metálicas simples e compostas. A Rótula Metalúrgica continua a se expandir, oferecendo soluções de alta qualidade para construções em estruturas pré-fabricadas e sempre superando as expectativas de nossos clientes. Nosso objetivo é entregar excelência em produtos, serviços e relacionamento com nossos clientes, colaboradores e parceiros . Por esse motivo, estamos em busca de Estagiários de Controle da Qualidade proativos que buscam contribuir com suas habilidades para a melhoria contínua e tenham forte abertura para o aprendizado e inovação.

Principais desafios do seu dia a dia:

  • Monitorar a qualidade da fabricação de estruturas metálicas;
  • Verificar os procedimentos operacionais de higiene e boas práticas de fabricação;
  • Inspecionar o recebimento e organizar o armazenamento e movimentação de matérias prima e insumos;
  • Verificar conformidade de processos, liberar produtos e serviços;
  • Trabalhar de acordo com as normas e procedimentos técnicos de qualidade;
  • Administrar toda a documentação técnica do controle de qualidade, certificados de matéria-prima e books;
  • Monitorar as validades das certificações dos profissionais e equipamentos;
  • Organizar e manter o arquivo de registros e documentações.

O que você precisa ter para fazer parte deste time:

  • Pacote office intermediário
  • Técnico ou superior em Qualidade

Será um diferencial: Conhecimento em processo de fabricação e montagem do setor metalúrgico (estruturas metálicas).

Se você se identifica com nossos valores e deseja construir uma carreira de sucesso conosco, inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time!

"Qualidade, Tradição e Inovação, desde 1989."

title: MEC NICO I
description:
Sobre a Rodobens

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Descrição da vaga

Sobre a Rodobens

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

Veículos Comerciais

Somos a maior rede de distribuição de veículos comerciais e peças genuínas Mercedes-Benz do país, com 27 pontos de venda presentes em 13 estados, tendo em seu portfólio caminhões, ônibus e utilitários. Representamos também a marca de pneus Michelin, referência mundial em seu ramo, o que também nos torna a maior distribuidora de pneus de carga da América Latina.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Realizar manutenções corretivas e preventivas em caminhões, ônibus e veículos utilitários, utilizando as ferramentas e os equipamentos necessários, para que todo o processo seja realizado de acordo com o manual técnico.
  • Efetuar pequenos reparos de mecânica, verificando a pressão de galeria, pressão de intercooler, trocas de correias e trocas de óleo, para que as especificações do fabricante sejam cumpridas.
  • Prezar pelo funcionamento e bom estado dos equipamentos, peças desmontadas e trocadas, averiguando e testando após o término da intervenção, a fim de cumprir as normas técnicas de segurança e procedimentos.
  • Zelar pelas ferramentas e equipamentos, mantendo a limpeza e a organização, a fim de conservar os instrumentos e o box de trabalho.
  • Analisar as ordens de serviços a serem executados, separando as ferramentas necessárias para as manutenções, a fim de diagnosticar e reparar falhas nos equipamentos.
  • Estabelecer e defender os valores fundamentais da Rodobens, promovendo e cumprindo o Código de Ética, bem como mantendo discrição frente às informações confidenciais de atuação, respeitando e cumprindo as normas legais e regulamentares, as políticas e as diretrizes estabelecidas para o negócio e para as atividades da empresa, buscando identificar, evitar e tratar quaisquer desvios ou inconformidades e riscos de Compliance que possam ocorrer. Promover a inclusão das responsabilidades de Compliance pertinentes às principais responsabilidades e atividades do cargo.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para Participar Do Nosso Processo Você Precisa Ter

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio Completo
  • Habilidades: Proatividade, organização, boa comunicação
  • Conhecimento obrigatório: Conhecimento técnico de mecânica automotiva ou similares
  • Conhecimento diferencial: Curso técnico de mecânica automotiva ou similares

Informações adicionais

Local De Trabalho

Área de Oficina da revenda Rodobens Mercedes Benz Veículos Comerciais - Salvador

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Benefícios pra você!

  • Refeitório
  • Vale transporte
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio farmácia
  • Descontos especiais em produtos comercializados pela Rodobens e parceiros credenciados
  • Cursos e treinamentos em várias competências na Universidade Rodobens
  • Seguro de vida em grupo
  • Sessões de psicoterapia
  • Desconto em aluguel de carro
  • PPR

Jornada De Trabalho

De segunda a sexta-feira, das 07h40 às 17h30 com 1h00 de almoço

SOBRE A GENTE

SER O PARCEIRO DO PRÓXIMO PASSO DA SUA CARREIRA!

Com mais de 70 anos de existência, a Rodobens vem trazendo soluções financeiras para empresas e pessoas, contemplando suas necessidades de acordo com cada processo. Tem sede em São José do Rio Preto/SP, com presença em todo o território nacional, possui uma sólida cultura de inovação e tradição ao entregar às pessoas clientes, fornecedoras, colaboradoras e parceiras uma experiência completa.

Somos especialistas em projetos de vida e possuímos uma plataforma de serviços financeiros, alavancada em um ecossistema de varejo automotivo, que distribui produtos e serviços em mais de 3.300 pontos de venda em todo o Brasil, combinando canais físicos e digitais, próprios e de parceiros.

Uma Empresa De Capital Aberto

Rodobens S.A tem o registro de emissor categoria A nas Comissões de Valores Mobiliários (CVM) e é listada no segmento básico da B3 S.A – Brasil, Bolsa & Balcão (B3). A Companhia possui admissão à negociação dos Certificados de Depósito de Ações representativos, cada um, de 01 ação ordinária e 02 ações preferenciais de emissão da Companhia (“Units”) no segmento básico da B3, com o nome de pregão “RODOBENS” e o código de negociação (ticker) RBNS. Estimulamos o desenvolvimento com valorização dos nossos talentos internos, investindo em capacitação e reconhecimento à alta performance por meio de um modelo de meritocracia eficaz. A Universidade Rodobens fundamentada para proporcionar um ambiente colaborativo, inovador e integrado aos colaboradores e colaboradoras da empresa. Conta com uma estrutura dedicada ao conhecimento para promover o encontro entre as habilidades dos nossos talentos com as necessidades do cliente, por meio de cursos e treinamentos, visando agregar valor duradouro às pessoas e aos negócios.

Investimos na capacitação, pois temos a crença absoluta que o desenvolvimento profissional traz ainda mais qualidade e melhores resultados aos nossos negócios, além de viabilizar o crescimento de cada integrante do nosso time. #VempraRodobens e dê o próximo passo de sucesso na sua carreira!

description:

O Auxiliar Administrativo - SAC é responsável por prestar suporte às atividades administrativas do setor de atendimento ao cliente, garantindo o registro, acompanhamento e resolução de demandas, reclamações e solicitações dos clientes de forma eficiente e cordial. Atua como elo entre o cliente e os demais departamentos da empresa, assegurando a satisfação e fidelização do público.

  • Preencher planilhas de controle e relatórios de atendimento;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de respostas padrão e comunicados aos clientes;

  • Contribuir com sugestões para melhoria dos processos de atendimento.

  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente ou rotinas administrativas;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

title: Community Manager, Latin America
description:
Welcome to the Management Commons Job Board! Below you will find career opportunities with dynamic fiscal sponsors and other innovative organizations!

Administrative Customer Service Education/Training Finance Human Resources Management Non-Profit/Volunteering Leadership Strategic Planning Advocacy

Job Type :
Full Time

Work Location:
Remote

About the Job

The ImPactis a US-based nonprofit organization with team members spread around the world.We are looking for a Community Manager to lead the growth and support of our member community in Latin America. This is a remote full-time position and we are looking for candidates based in Brazil, Chile, or Mexico.

As a Community Manager, you will work with our members and other ImPact team members to inspire, support, and co-create action – both individually and collectively – to increase the flow of capital towards impact. The Community Manager will report to The ImPact’s Director of Community based in Santiago, Chile and will work closely with the Senior Director for community growth and support.

The Community Manager for Latin America will develop a vision and strategy for The ImPact’s community growth, support, and engagement with the surrounding impact ecosystem in the region, in alignment with The ImPact’s global vision and strategy. The Community Manager for Latin America will be responsible for developing a financial and operational plan pursuant to the regional vision and strategy, including the gathering of mission-aligned revenues alongside member contributions. The Community Manager for Latin America will also design and deliver individual support and collaborative experiences for the members in their region to help them make more impact investing more effectively. Overall, the Community Manager for Latin America is responsible and accountable for the setting and accomplishment of membership growth and engagement targets within their region, in alignment with The ImPact’s global goals.

We are a global, remote team with team members based in the US, France, Chile, and Singapore. We work across multiple time zones and our core ways of working are anchored in a combination of virtual synchronous meetings and asynchronous discussion and collaboration in writing and using other virtual collaborative tools. We also believe that consistent in-person connection and collaboration is important - for relationship building, team members’ professional growth, and effective work. Our global team meets in-person at least once a year at a team retreat or our global, annual member events.

The ImPact offers competitive salaried compensation, commensurate with experience and location, and generous benefits that vary by labor market.

Primary Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Relationship Management (40%): You will build strong and authentic relationships with all of The ImPact’s members based in Latin America, developing a deep understanding of their individual and family impact investment interests and areas of need. You will develop a customized plan of membership for each individual member that will provide the experiences, best practices, and relationships to support them in making progress towards their impact goals and have regular conversations with the members. You will forge connections among these members to best serve their individual and collective needs and facilitate peer-to-peer exchange of knowledge, data, and insights.
  • Member Recruitment (30%) : You will actively identify families who could benefit from and contribute to The ImPact’s unique peer-to-peer community through individual and collaborative outreach withThe ImPact’s global team and current members. You will work with the Director of Community to set regional growth targets and help open the funnel through distribution channel partnerships and participating in regional events. You are also responsible for the end-to-end recruitment process for prospective members, including assessing their initial interest and fit, coordinating the member endorsement process, supporting the formal invitation process, and conducting onboarding with new members.
  • Curation of Local & Global Experiences (25%): You will be responsible for developing a robust yearly calendar of experiences for members and prospective members in the region, selecting themes, curating content, and ensuring strong participation from members and prospective members. These experiences are designed to build lasting and productive relationships among members, provide knowledge and insights, and enable each participant to advance their own impact investing activities. You will also work with the global team to design, create, or adapt tools or other educational resources that deepen members’ knowledge of impact investing or enable them to take specific actions related to implementing their impact investment strategies.
  • Building Regional Strategy and Partnerships (5%) : You will set annual and quarterly Objectives and Key Results for Latin America as a whole. You will work closely with the Director of Community to build strong partnerships with organizations that can help advance The ImPact’s mission and relevance within Latin America..
  • Support team projects where needed .

Job Requirements

  • At least five years of experience in a relationship management role within a member services organization, a family office, or a family foundation
  • Demonstrated experience in and passion for community building and relationship management
  • Knowledge of the impact investment, private investment, and philanthropy ecosystems a plus
  • Social and emotional intelligence to effectively communicate and build authentic and lasting relationships across generations, cultures, national, and regional boundaries
  • Ability to “connect the dots” between diverse themes and people
  • A high level of discretion for both professional and personal affairs
  • Work independently and have the drive, patience, and resilience to get up a rapid learning curve and to build things from scratch
  • A desire to solve the world’s biggest problems and a belief in the power of impact investing to help do so
  • Ability to work harmoniously with a diverse team and comfort working independently with a remote team members across different time zones and using technology platforms
  • Fluency in Spanish and English, fluency in Portuguese language a plus
  • Flexibility to travel 20% of the time

Salary Range

USD

About the Organization

The ImPact is a global membership community, “by families, for families.” Families and their internal staff join The ImPact to learn with and from their peers how to align investment and philanthropic assets to create lasting positive change.

Our mission is to help families make more impact investments more effectively. For nearly 10 years, we have guided and supported families in the alignment of their values with all sources of family capital - philanthropic, investment, and family-owned businesses.

description:
Esta é uma oportunidade para você fazer parte de nosso banco de talentos no Infnet . Mas o que é isso?

O banco de talentos é uma forma de você enviar seu currículo e já realizar algumas etapas comuns aos processos seletivos do corpo técnico administrativo. Assim, quando surgir uma vaga alinhada ao seu perfil, você já sai na frente.

Este banco de talentos não é para professores, instrutores, trainees ou estagiários.

  • As vagas para o corpo técnico administrativo têm carga horária de 44 horas semanais , usualmente de segunda a sexta-feira.
  • Oportunidade para crescer no Instituto Infnet, uma faculdade com foco em Engenharias Tech, Ciência de Dados, Comunicação e Design Digital.
  • Oportunidade de continuar os estudos na instituição, com direito a bolsas para graduação e pós-graduação .
  • Ambiente universitário que favorece seu aprendizado , com acesso à biblioteca para estudos e networking com professores e profissionais da área.

Para estas vagas, os candidatos devem ter bom nível de atenção e demonstrar habilidades de comunicação .

Há oportunidades para trabalho nas seguintes áreas:

  • Secretaria e Registro Acadêmico
  • Recursos Humanos, R&S e DP
  • TI e Suporte
  • Desenvolvimento de Software
  • Infraestrutura e manutenção

Estes requisitos são comuns para todas as vagas deste banco de talentos:

Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Ser capaz de se comunicar por escrito com clareza e sem erros de português
  • Ter bom raciocínio lógico e um bom nível de atenção na execução de tarefas
  • Proatividade, postura profissional e responsabilidade
  • Facilidade no aprendizado de softwares
  • Domínio das ferramentas Google, especialmente Documentos e Planilhas

Todas as vagas contam com os seguintes benefícios:

  • Vale-transporte, para os dias de trabalho presencial
  • Vale-refeição em cartão flexível Swile
  • Plano de saúde pela Unimed ou Amil e plano odontológico pela Amil
  • Dia livre de aniversário a partir de um ano de casa
  • Possibilidade de participar dos cursos oferecidos pela instituição em condições especiais para colaboradores, incluindo bolsas integrais de graduação após o período de experiência e bolsas parciais de pós-graduação
  • Possibilidade de bolsa para dependentes e/ou cônjuge após dois anos de trabalho na instituição

Conheça mais sobre o Instituto Infnet

O Instituto Infnet é uma instituição de ensino de alto nível e orientada ao mercado de trabalho sediada no Rio de Janeiro. É composta pela Faculdade Infnet e pela ECDD (Escola de Comunicação e Design Digital). Fundado em 1994, o Instituto cresceu junto com a Internet no Brasil, acompanhando toda a sua evolução e sendo um importante pivô para sua difusão.

A Faculdade Infnet é referência em engenharias tech. Oferece cursos de graduação e pós-graduação a distância e presenciais em áreas como Engenharia e Desenvolvimento de Software, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia de Redes e Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de Banco de Dados, Ciência de Dados e Inteligência Artificial. Possui sede no Centro do Rio de Janeiro, próximo à estação Carioca.

A ECDD (Escola de Comunicação e Design Digital) é a faculdade dos criativos. Oferece programas de graduação e pós-graduação a distância e presenciais, todos na área de criação. Os principais campos dos cursos são Design Gráfico e Digital, Publicidade e Marketing, Design de Games, Design de Animação, Cinema e Audiovisual. A ECDD também fica sediada no Centro do Rio de Janeiro, em um charmoso prédio tombado pelo Corredor Cultural.

title: Data Scientist II / Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from home. As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance.

We are looking for candidates who are creative, self-driven, curious, people-oriented and comfortable defining a path through ambiguity towards high-level goals. The successful applicants will collaborate closely with people across Microsoft’s product teams and Microsoft Research to see their ideas realized in products and services that are used worldwide, as well as to contribute back to the scientific community and beyond (e.g. via presentations, publications, media interviews, and similar). Come to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

As a Data Scientist , you will help transform how Copilot features are evaluated and improved. Your team will deliver end-to-end experimentation, evaluation, and insights to Copilot engineers, PMs, and fellow scientists. You’ll work on the data generation platform that creates algorithms and ML pipelines for simulating user actions and datasets that reflect real-world usage and user preferences and develop metrics that go beyond accuracy – capturing nuance, intent, and satisfaction. You’ll work on scalable pipelines that support offline evaluations for Copilot Search, BizChat, Connectors, and Agents (DAs). This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities (detailed)

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

Main qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset with resilience and a passion for learning.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. Consistent with applicable law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Senior Software Engineer (Lending)
description:
About the Role

You will work closely with the product and credit teams to build go-to-market functions for our lending decisioning engine. You’ll debug and resolve complex issues independently, anticipate potential blockers, and help unblock others when needed.

You will evaluate scope and requirements critically by surfacing ambiguities early, challenging assumptions, and reframing trade-offs to ensure clarity before execution. Progress, risks, and blockers should be communicated proactively through tickets, stand-ups, and async updates to keep teammates and stakeholders aligned.

You will provide detailed peer reviews that improve code quality, maintainability, and extensibility. In addition, you’ll drive continuous improvement by identifying technical debt, proposing design or tooling enhancements, and sharing best practices that increase team velocity and reliability.

About the Team

The team develops Clutch's real-time lending decisioning engine. We work closely with Credit, Product, and Implementation teams to increase auto-decision rates and reduce funding time for our credit union partners. The team operates with a clear cadence and shared rituals, using narrative-driven planning and continuous improvement to ship reliably while collaborating across the broader Lending org.

Engineers own outcomes end to end, from discovery and decision-ready specs through rollout, monitoring, and follow-ups.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Debug and resolve issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Take ownership of smaller features end-to-end, from clarifying requirements to deployment.

  • Build working knowledge of decisioning engine features and rules, being able to explain their impact on the product.

  • Proactively ask questions, surface risks, and challenge assumptions early to improve clarity and scope of work.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Drive predictable delivery by proactively communicating progress, risks, and blockers without being prompted.

  • Confidently operate on lending decisioning context, making informed tradeoffs and documenting decisions.

  • Lead technical implementation for a feature or partner go-live, coordinating with stakeholders for alignment.

  • Anticipate potential problems in requirements or design, reframing them with data and alternative solutions before they become blockers.

  • Contribute high-quality code reviews that not only ensure standards, but also provide mentorship and elevate peers’ design and coding practices.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Lead and deliver a small-to-medium scoped project independently, including technical design, planning, and rollout.

  • Build trust with cross-functional and external stakeholders by representing engineering context and constraints clearly.

  • Proactively identify technical debt or process gaps and drive initiatives to resolve them with measurable impact.

  • Demonstrate readiness for the next level by consistently owning delivery, influencing peers, and shaping team practices that raise the overall bar.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong product-oriented mindset, able to connect technical decisions with business impact.

  • Proven ability to debug and resolve complex issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Credit, Implementation, and external stakeholders to align on scope and trade-offs.

  • Consistent ownership of small-to-medium projects end-to-end, from discovery and design to deployment and follow-up.

  • Ability to critically evaluate requirements, anticipate risks, and propose pragmatic alternatives that improve clarity and delivery outcomes.

  • Advanced English skills, both spoken and written.

  • Plus: previous experience with loan origination systems is a strong differentiator.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.

  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Feedzai is securing the transition to a cashless world while enabling digital trust in every transaction and payment type. The world’s largest banks, processors, and retailers trust Feedzai to protect trillions of dollars and manage risk while improving the customer experience for everyday users, without compromising privacy. Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of +$1.5B, the company's technology protects 900 million people in 190 countries.

You:

Feedzai is looking for an Engagement Manager/Business Analyst who has strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills and demonstrates a strong passion for client success and product adoption. This role will serve as the leader for the delivery of the Order Form for our customers, which will include milestones such as defining the scope, stakeholder identification, data dictionary definition, and more.
You will combine product expertise with business acumen and general project management skills to lead the client through the implementation phase of each project. Being the client's primary point of contact, you should be able to coordinate multiple priorities and ensure the client can overcome any obstacles during the implementation process. You should continuously grow your professional skills through training, self-development, and by successfully guiding clients in integrating Feedzai’s products to prevent financial crime.

Your Day to Day:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for Feedzai’s customers and foster positive relationships with them;
  • Identify each client’s expectations and requirements and effectively communicate them across functional teams;
  • Become a subject matter expert of Feedzai’s products and advise clients about best practices;
  • Collaborate with the client with the support of Data Science and Risk Analyst teams to map the client’s fields to Feedzai’s standard API data dictionary;
  • Design process flows with an understanding of the customer’s event flow and current state;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a multicultural environment;
  • Address customer issues with speed and efficiency;
  • Perform project management tasks such as communicating the project status to both internal and external stakeholders, reminding clients about implementation milestones along with their due dates, facilitating meetings, taking meeting notes, and leading the product activation from start to finish;
  • Work with the portfolio manager to manage client backlog and understand client timelines;
  • Define and assess project risks and effectively devise mitigation plans;
  • Provide updates to internal cross-functional partners (Product Management, Product Development, Portfolio Managers) on customer perspectives, risks, strategic insights, issue resolution activities, and expansion opportunities;
  • Collaborate with the product and software development teams to ensure customer feedback is incorporated into our product roadmap;
  • Translate technical client requirements into user stories to be consumed by the Engineering team for implementation.

You Have & You Know-how:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Management, Engineering or similar field;
  • At least 2 years experience in a Business Analyst role with responsibility for requirement elicitation;
  • Familiarity with API mapping and design;
  • Demonstrated skills in managing customer relationships for a managed services and/or SaaS organization;
  • Project management experience, including the ability to effectively prioritize different clients’ deliverables;
  • Experience being hands-on with leading Customer Onboarding and Implementations;
  • Experience with the full Standard Development Lifecycle (SDLC);
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills;
  • Leadership, adaptability, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills;
  • Be solution-oriented and take initiative when issues arise;
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills;
  • Ability to manage client expectations and push back when necessary;
  • Experience leading workshops and project initiation meetings;
  • Experience with Visio or similar flowcharting software;
  • Understanding of data/schema definitions such as JSON and XML.

Your First 30-Days at Feedzai:

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

  • DevOps & Release Management: Experience with environment management, release management, code versioning, and deployment methodologies.

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;

title: Head of Recovery Strategy, Process and Programs
description:
About Upstart

Upstart is the leading AI lending marketplace partnering with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. By leveraging Upstart's AI marketplace, Upstart-powered banks and credit unions can have higher approval rates and lower loss rates across races, ages, and genders, while delivering the digital-first lending experience their customers demand. More than 80% of borrowers are approved instantly, with zero documentation to upload.

Upstart is a digital-first company, which means that most Upstarters live and work anywhere in the United States. However, we also have offices in San Mateo, California; Columbus, Ohio; and Austin, Texas.

Most Upstarters join us because they connect with our mission of enabling access to effortless credit based on true risk. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Upstart, we’d love to hear from you!

The Team

The Recovery team at Upstart is responsible for maximizing post-default recoveries while ensuring compliant, borrower-centric engagement across a diverse and growing vendor ecosystem. As our Recovery operations mature, we are investing in building smarter, more scalable systems that reduce manual risk, improve data-driven decisions, and align our vendor network with long-term strategic outcomes.

We are seeking a Head of Recovery Strategy, Process & Programs to lead our transformation roadmap across vendor integration, automation, compliance infrastructure, and intelligent placement logic. This individual will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data Analytics, and Operations to architect the next evolution of Recovery operations at Upstart.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead Recovery’s transformation roadmap: Design and deliver high-impact initiatives that reduce manual risk, automate vendor workflows, and scale internal process efficiency across legal recovery, bankruptcy, affidavits, DSC, debt sales, and probate.
  • Architect scalable vendor infrastructure: Enhance frameworks for vendor onboarding, integration, compliance scorecards, and audit-readiness, ensuring Recovery is built to scale intelligently across a growing multi-vendor ecosystem.

THE COMPANY: Juul Labs has a mission to transition the world’s billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The Director, Cycle Planning is responsible for leading Juul Labs’ end-to-end commercial cycle planning process—translating strategic priorities into integrated, market-ready execution plans. This role ensures that product launches, promotions, consumer programs, and other commercial activities are strategically sequenced and operationally aligned to maximize business impact.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO, the Director will partner with Sales, Brand, Go-to-Market (GTM), Demand Planning, and Operations to define objectives, set target metrics, and align tactical execution plans for each cycle. This includes managing dependencies, identifying risks and conflicts, and ensuring that all commercial activities are timed and resourced to deliver against volume, revenue, and market share goals. The Director will also serve as the central point of coordination for cycle planning inputs across the U.S. and International markets, ensuring integration with demand planning, resource allocation, and commercial governance processes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Commercial Cycle Planning Process
    • Own the development and management of JUUL Labs’ commercial cycle plans from strategy definition to execution readiness.
    • Partner with Commercial, Sales, and Brand leaders to set objectives, define KPIs, and prioritize activities within each cycle.
    • Integrate New Product Introductions (NPIs), promotions, and consumer programs into unified execution strategies that align with corporate and market priorities.
    • Maintain a forward-looking view of the cycle calendar to ensure proactive planning and risk mitigation.
  • Strategic Sequencing & Alignment
    • Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions to align activity sequencing for maximum commercial impact.
    • Identify and resolve conflicts, capacity constraints, and dependencies across initiatives.
    • Ensure cycle planning decisions consider operational lead times, regulatory requirements, and market readiness.
    • Partner with Demand Planning to ensure cycle strategies are supported by accurate forecasts and inventory availability.
  • Integration with Demand Planning & Governance
    • Ensure cycle plans are integrated into the broader commercial execution calendar and governance processes.
    • Collaborate with the demand planning team to align forecasts with cycle objectives and promotional plans.
    • Support the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO in preparing cycle planning updates for the Commercial Executive Team.
  • Planning Tools & Process Improvement
    • Maintain and evolve standardized cycle planning templates, tools, and workflows.
    • Drive process improvements to increase visibility, alignment, and execution efficiency across the commercial organization.
    • Partner with the PMO team to incorporate cycle planning milestones into initiative tracking dashboards.

PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years in commercial planning, marketing operations, or related commercial execution roles.
  • Proven experience managing integrated planning processes that span multiple functions and markets.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive consensus.
  • Ability to manage complex calendars and dependencies across product launches, promotions, and market programs.
  • Experience in CPG, nicotine/tobacco, or other regulated industries.

Preferred:

  • Experience leading Cycle Planning efforts in a commercial organization
  • Familiarity with enterprise planning tools and demand planning systems.
  • Experience integrating commercial planning with S&OP processes.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field.

  • People. Work with talented, committed and supportive teammates

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Centerstone is among the nation’s leading nonprofit behavioral health systems with thousands of employees dedicated to delivering care that changes people’s lives. A dynamic, well-established organization, we offer rewarding opportunities to serve all ages in a variety of settings. Come talk to us about joining the Centerstone team!

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Enterprise Risk Manager is responsible for ongoing risk assessment and mitigation as documented in the Risk Management Plan. Develops and maintains systems within the organization to detect, monitor, prevent, organize, measure, investigate, report, and manage patient adverse events, malpractice claims, incident reports, and other indicators of potential patient harm. The organization’s key aims in this area are to be a high reliability organization that integrate a Just Culture framework toward a culture of patient safety.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinates the risk management program for the organization and facilitates patient safety activities within the Centerstone Patient Safety Organization.
  • Performs investigation of potentially reportable incident(s) to local regulatory agencies
  • Interfaces with the on-site investigators reporting potential claims as well as cases of concern by preparation of preliminary reports, and determination of priority of investigation given risk management assessment.
  • Conducts risk assessments, collecting and analyzing documentation, statistics, reports, and market trends.
  • Communicates high risk and/or high-profile events with Centerstone legal representatives and/or external insurance carriers
  • Recommends policies and procedures to identify and address risks in the organizations services and departments.
  • Investigate and analyze actual and potential risks within the organization; assess liability and probability of legal action for potential notification.
  • Review incident/safety concerns with the leadership team to identify systemic issues and facilitate the development of corrective actions. Recommends and implements risk management solutions such as insurance, safety and security policies, business continuity plans, environment of care, or recovery measures.
  • Coordinates with necessary health and safety leaders throughout the organization to ensure an environment of care that is safe for clients and a workplace that is safe for staff and stakeholders
  • Works collaboratively with management and leadership to conduct a comprehensive risk assessment on an annual basis
  • Recommends a risk management plan for the health system on an annual basis
  • Provides data to leadership necessary to inform risk mitigation strategies for the organization

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Proven management ability and experience including a thorough understanding of quality improvement (QI) processes, tools, and techniques; quality measurement and reporting; root cause analysis and preventive risk management strategies; accrediting bodies’ standards; and state and federal regulations.
  • Knowledge of risk information management systems (RIMS).
  • Ability to effectively interact and lead risk management activities across multi-state locations and business units

QUALIFICATIONS

Education Level

Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree in healthcare related field required

Years of Experience

Minimum of three (3) years of risk related experience in a behavioral healthcare setting required

Certification/Licensure

Currently a certified professional healthcare risk manager (CPHRM), or eligible to obtain within 6 months of hire

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Standing – 20%

Sitting – 80%

Squatting – Occasional

Kneeling – Occasional

Bending – Occasional

Driving – Occasional

Lifting – Occasional

description:
Community Sales Manager

Av. Tancredo Neves, 620
33° andar
Caminho das Árvores
Salvador
Bahia, Brazil

At Regus, we’ve built the world’s largest workspace network so that our customers can work better, faster, happier. Join the team in one of our business centres. Promote our products and services to new and existing customers. Bring more freedom to more people and businesses. And you’ll be able to work better, faster and happier too.

The opportunity

As a Community Sales Manager, you’ll be responsible for the smooth running of your Regus centre while finding ways to increase sales and revenue, helping more and more people enjoy the benefits of flexible working. You’ll motivate your team to create a great working environment to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.

A typical day at Regus

You start the day with an informal team talk over coffee, to plan the day and make sure everyone’s prepared.

With one eye always on reception, you see members turning up and also the first meeting rooms guests arriving. You welcome them and take them to their meeting room, show them the facilities and help them set up their WiFi connections and AV system for their presentation.

Later you have a meeting to learn more about a new member and get to understand his business needs. You think about the other businesses in the centre and how you might be able to introduce him to a couple that may be of interest at the networking event later in the week.

A large company is taking a whole floor of the centre and is moving in next week. You run through the move in detail with the reception team, ensuring the welcome kit is prepared, and all badges and keys are ready for handing over.

At lunchtime a couple walk in enquiring about coworking membership. Your colleague from sales is on their lunch break so you offer them a coffee and give them a tour of the centre, explaining all the benefits of Regus membership.

Later in the afternoon you host a monthly operations meeting for Community Sales Managers from your local cluster of centres, along with the regional Operations Manager. After the meeting you do a final walk around the building, speaking with members, asking how their day went as they start to wind down and head for home.

About you

We’re looking for someone who has the experience and aptitude to manage a smooth running operation. You’ll need to be an accomplished multitasker, able to pre-empt issues before they become problems, and keep a team motivated and focused on service excellence. You also need to be:

  • A good communicator, used to dealing with customers – ideally in the hospitality or events industry
  • Confident, approachable and able to build strong relationships with customers
  • A great manager, who leads by example and knows how to motivate and inspire a team
  • Happy taking ownership of problems and finding ways to solve them
  • Positive, enthusiastic and able to adapt to fast-changing situations
  • Confident using MS Office and other basic IT packages

In addition, you will:

  • Manage the day to day running of the centre, focusing on exceptional customer service
  • Inspire your team of associates, developing their skills to get the best from each team member
  • Promote your centre to new customers and show them how flexible workspace could enhance their business
  • Generate leads by delivering engaging networking events within your community

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary package you’ll enjoy:

  • A bright and inspiring work environment
  • Training and development opportunities

title: Lead Technician II
description:
Overview

SitelogIQ is a world-class team making a large-scale impact on the efficiency and sustainability of the places we live, work, shop, and heal.

SitelogIQ delivers turnkey energy efficiency and property improvement programs that transform built environments and breathe life into the sustainability, financial, and resiliency goals of real estate teams and corporations across the U.S. Our mission is to make buildings better while making it easy for our clients to accelerate their impact.

Job Summary

Working out of our Commercial Markets Division , the Lead Technician II role is critical to the day-to-day management of our crews and projects, including but not limited to electrical functions testing, installation, pinpointing, commissioning, and troubleshooting EV and electrical components; keeping the jobsite organized and running smoothly. This position requires a high attention to detail and accuracy as well as very clear and proactive communication skills, both with internal teammates as well as safety professionals. All members of our team are expected to work together in a safe, positive, respectful, and professional manner.

Responsibilities

  • Perform electrical/EV installation work and provide direction and site supervision to installation team.
  • Verify material requirements and develop installation plan for project and communicate the plan to all technicians and installers.
  • Field installation of project scope ensuring all work is performed according to electrical code and is completed in a timely manner.
  • Provide regular and timely project information to the operations team regarding project progress, installation variance, manpower resources, equipment rental, and differences in contract project scope.
  • Obtain an understanding of project scope of work from supervisor including any available plans or documents.
  • Close out projects by conducting quality assurance and prevention, jurisdiction inspections, and any final verification of scope and quality.
  • Responsible for all aspects of lighting service including lamp, ballast replacement and troubleshooting.
  • Install, replace, or repair EV charging stations including all electrical work and troubleshooting as needed.
  • Perform EV charging audits as required.
  • Must be able to perform job tasks with no supervision.
  • Adhere to safety policy as well as rules and regulations.

Qualifications

  • Ten (10) or more years of Commercial and/or Residential electrical experience beyond lighting installation
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred
  • NRLT or CSLT is a plus
  • Journeyman License is a plus
  • Adhere to safety policy as well as rules and regulations
  • Maintain active driver’s license with a clean record and have reliable transportation to report to various job locations

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

  • Able to move or lift 50 lbs. unassisted
  • Able to withstand varying temperatures typical in an outdoor environment
  • Position spends significant amount of time standing, walking, lifting, pulling, and pushing
  • Ability to travel overnight and extended periods of time
  • Position may require climbing of ladders and/or working from heights
  • Position requires 70% travel to regional projects and to other states, based on business needs

Benefits

We offer a highly competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Disability and life insurance
  • 401K
  • Flex time off
  • 12 paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Opportunities to drive our DE&I efforts by joining our affinity groups, Veterans and Allies Leadership Organization, or Women Inspiring & Strengthening Everyone
  • Opportunities to give back to our local communities through organized events or fundraisers

More About SitelogIQ
